referenceMeta.methodology: Stable shuffled batches with opaque IDs; author design targets and production scores were hidden. Four criterion bands came from an independent Pro reference examiner and Overall was calculated from their equal average.

Task Achievement.diagnosis: All requirements are covered appropriately, relevantly and sufficiently; the purpose is clear, each bullet is well developed, and tone is consistently formal and polite, with only occasional, minor content lapses (e.g., slightly over-extended emotional detail).

result.overallAssessment: A strong complaint letter demonstrating highly proficient vocabulary and grammatical control. All task requirements are met with relevant detail and appropriate tone, though a slight tendency toward emotional language and a single mechanical transition prevent the highest bands in Task Achievement and Coherence and Cohesion. Lexical Resource reaches Band 9, while Grammar reaches 8.5 due to an extremely subtle punctuation imprecision.

criterionContrastAudit.comparison: TA is strongest because all bullets are fully covered with relevant, well-extended detail and appropriate formal register throughout. GRA is weakest because while most sentences are error-free, there are a few minor but noticeable errors (missing comma, non-standard phrase) that prevent full flexibility and control expected at Band 7.

Task Achievement is strongest because all bullet points are fully addressed with relevant, well-developed detail. Grammatical Range and Accuracy is weakest due to a narrow range of structures and minor but noticeable errors in punctuation and preposition use.
criterionContrastAudit.uniformProfileJustification: All four criteria are scored at 6.5 because each shows clear strengths appropriate to Band 7 but is held back by recurring limitations that prevent the next band. Task Achievement is fully covered but lacks only the natural, proportionate development of Band 7. Coherence and Cohesion has clear progression but some mechanical transitions. Lexical Resource is adequate with some precise vocabulary but suffers from occasional imprecision and repetition. Grammatical Range and Accuracy shows good control of simple forms but limited flexibility in complex structures. The dominant pattern across all criteria is a secure Band 6 performance with strong elements reaching toward Band 7, hence the half band.

criterionContrastAudit.comparison: Lexical Resource shows wide, precise and flexible vocabulary with skilful collocation and only extremely rare minor slips, clearly outperforming the other criteria. Task Achievement is the weakest because while all bullets are addressed with relevant detail, the development is slightly conventional and one point (how the problem has affected you) is over-elaborated with emotional language that slightly reduces the functional focus expected of a complaint letter, though it still meets Band 8 requirements overall.

scoreCalculation.formula: The final AI-selected four criterion bands are averaged equally and rounded to the nearest half band. General examiner and specialist results are never averaged together.
